districtFact: CMSD families cannot rely on one generic first day: the 205-day extended-year programs at Downtown Education Center and The School of One start August 10, traditional grades 1–12 start August 24, kindergarten starts August 28, and Pre-K phases in before its first full day September 8.

districtFaqs.q: Do kindergarten and Pre-K students start on August 24?
districtFaqs.a: No. Kindergarten starts August 28. Pre-K phases in September 1–4 before its first full day September 8. August 24 is the traditional opening for students in grades 1–12.

districtFaqs.q: Which CMSD students follow the extended-year calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Students at Downtown Education Center and The School of One follow the separate 205-day extended-year calendar. They start August 10, 2026 and finish June 16, 2027.

districtFaqs.q: Are all CMSD professional-development Fridays districtwide no-school days?
districtFaqs.a: No. Several dates apply only to kindergarten or only to Pre-K. The February 12 district professional-development day closes schools more broadly.

districtFaqs.q: Does a CMSD parent-teacher conference day always mean no school?
districtFaqs.a: No. November 2 is a full no-school day for students, while February 11 and April 14 use early dismissal and an extended teacher day.

districtFaqs.q: Is the linked 2026–27 CMSD calendar approved or a draft?
districtFaqs.a: The official district page labels it the approved calendar, but the linked PDF still carries a DRAFT watermark and gives conflicting student-day totals. The dates are listed here, but the conflicting total is not.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families check CMSD weather closures?
districtFaqs.a: Check the district website and social channels. CMSD says there is no single automatic temperature or wind-chill closure threshold; officials also consider road conditions and forecasts.
